BuyerProfile.title: BuyerProfile
BuyerProfile.description: Represents a patron or customer using the Koop app to place orders.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BuyerProfile entity.

name.description: The full name of the buyer.

email.description: The email address of the buyer.

currentLatitude.description: The current latitude of the buyer's device for map display and delivery tracking.

currentLongitude.description: The current longitude of the buyer's device for map display and delivery tracking.

subscriberStatus.description: Indicates if the buyer has an active subscription or special status, updated upon successful payment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the buyer profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the buyer profile was last updated.

Seller.title: Seller
Seller.description: Represents a beverage cart driver or vendor managing menus and fulfilling orders.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Seller entity.

name.description: The name of the seller or venue.

email.description: The email address of the seller for contact and login.

contactPhone.description: The primary contact phone number for the seller.

currentLatitude.description: The current latitude of the seller's beverage cart for real-time tracking.

currentLongitude.description: The current longitude of the seller's beverage cart for real-time tracking.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the seller profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the seller profile was last updated.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Defines a generic item that can be sold, such as a beverage or snack.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

name.description: The name of the product (e.g., 'Bottled Water', 'Craft Beer A').

description.description: A detailed description of the product.

category.description: The category the product belongs to (e.g., 'Beer', 'Spirits', 'Soft Drinks', 'Snacks').

imageUrl.description: URL to an image of the product.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the product was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the product was last updated.

SellerMenu.title: SellerMenu
SellerMenu.description: Represents a specific menu configuration offered by a seller, which groups various menu items.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SellerMenu entity.

sellerId.description: Reference to the Seller who owns this menu. (Relationship: Seller 1:N SellerMenu)

name.description: The name of the menu (e.g., 'Main Beverage Menu', 'Snack Bar Menu').

description.description: A brief description of the menu.

isActive.description: Indicates if this menu is currently active and visible to buyers.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the seller menu was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the seller menu was last updated.

MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: Represents a specific product offered on a SellerMenu, including its price and availability.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MenuItem entity.

sellerMenuId.description: Reference to the SellerMenu this item belongs to. (Relationship: SellerMenu 1:N MenuItem)

productId.description: Reference to the Product being offered. (Relationship: Product 1:N MenuItem)

price.description: The price of the product when sold through this menu item.

isAvailable.description: Indicates if the product is currently available for purchase through this menu item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the menu item was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the menu item was last updated.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a customer's placed order for items from a specific seller.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Order entity.

buyerProfileId.description: Reference to the BuyerProfile who placed the order. (Relationship: BuyerProfile 1:N Order)

sellerId.description: Reference to the Seller who will fulfill the order. (Relationship: Seller 1:N Order)

orderDateTime.description: The date and time the order was placed.

status.description: The current status of the order (e.g., 'Placed', 'Preparing', 'Out for Delivery', 'Delivered', 'Cancelled').

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the order, including all items and taxes/fees.

deliveryLatitude.description: The latitude of the specified delivery location for this order.

deliveryLongitude.description: The longitude of the specified delivery location for this order.

estimatedDeliveryTime.description: The estimated time of delivery for the order.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the order was last updated.

OrderItem.title: OrderItem
OrderItem.description: Represents a single item included in an Order, linking to a specific menu item.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OrderItem entity.

orderId.description: Reference to the Order this item belongs to. (Relationship: Order 1:N OrderItem)

menuItemId.description: Reference to the MenuItem that was ordered. (Relationship: MenuItem 1:N OrderItem)

quantity.description: The quantity of the item ordered.

priceAtTimeOfOrder.description: The price of the item at the moment the order was placed, to ensure historical accuracy.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order item was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the order item was last updated.

PaymentTransaction.title: PaymentTransaction
PaymentTransaction.description: Records details of a payment transaction, primarily for orders processed via Authorize.net.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PaymentTransaction entity.

orderId.description: Reference to the Order associated with this payment. (Relationship: Order 1:1 PaymentTransaction)

buyerProfileId.description: Reference to the BuyerProfile who made the payment. (Relationship: BuyerProfile 1:N PaymentTransaction)

transactionDateTime.description: The date and time when the payment transaction occurred.

amount.description: The total amount processed in this transaction.

status.description: The status of the payment transaction (e.g., 'Pending', 'Success', 'Failed', 'Refunded', 'Voided').

paymentGatewayTransactionId.description: The unique transaction ID provided by the payment gateway (e.g., Authorize.net).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the payment transaction record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the payment transaction record was last updated.

params.name: menuId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific seller menu.

params.description: The unique identifier of the menu this item belongs to.

definition.description: A control collection used for Database Access Control (DBAC). The existence of a document at this path signifies that the user (`adminUid`) holds the Koop Admin role. This is a conceptual entity for role management and adheres to 'Existence over Content' for global roles.

params.description: The unique identifier of a user who is designated as a Koop Admin.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is meticulously designed to prioritize Authorization Independence, ensure Queryable Access Patterns (QAPs), and establish explicit Database Access Control (DBAC). This approach minimizes complexity in security rules, enhances debuggability, and scales efficiently.

Authorization Independence and Denormalization (Mandate A):
To eliminate the need for `get()` calls in security rules, which can break atomic operations and complicate debugging, critical authorization context is denormalized directly into relevant documents:
*   MenuItem: Each `MenuItem` document within `/sellers/{sellerId}/menus/{menuId}/items/{itemId}` will include `menuIsActive` (a boolean denormalized from its parent `SellerMenu`) and `sellerId` (implicit in the path, but valuable for direct rule checks). This ensures that a buyer's read access to a menu item can be determined solely by checking `resource.data.isAvailable` and `resource.data.menuIsActive` on the item itself.
*   OrderItem: Each `OrderItem` document within `/orders/{orderId}/items/{orderItemId}` will denormalize `buyerProfileId` and `sellerId` from its parent `Order` document. This allows security rules to grant access to order items based on the authenticated user's `uid` matching either the buyer or the seller, without requiring a `get()` call to the parent `Order` document.
*   Order and PaymentTransaction: These top-level collections (`/orders/{orderId}` and `/paymentTransactions/{transactionId}`) are designed with `buyerProfileId` and `sellerId` (for Order) or `buyerProfileId` (for PaymentTransaction) as inherent fields in their schemas. This directly supports authorization checks and QAPs without needing external document lookups.

Queryable Access Patterns (QAPs) and Structural Segregation (Mandate B & C):
The structure enables efficient and secure `list` operations, a critical aspect for app performance and robust security rules:
*   Buyer Profiles (`/users/{userId}/buyerProfile`): This private, path-based ownership collection directly links a buyer's profile to their Firebase `uid`, making personal data retrieval simple and secure. QAP: `db.collection('users').doc(request.auth.uid).collection('buyerProfile')`.
*   Seller Profiles (`/sellers/{sellerId}`): This collection allows sellers to manage their own profiles. For public display on buyer maps, fields like `currentLatitude`, `currentLongitude`, and `name` are made readable by authenticated users, while sensitive data remains restricted. QAP: `db.collection('sellers').where(...)` for public visibility.
*   Global Products (`/products/{productId}`): A top-level collection providing a universal product catalog. It is efficiently queryable by all authenticated users, with write access strictly limited to Koop Admins. QAP: `db.collection('products')`.
*   Seller-Owned Menus and Items (`/sellers/{sellerId}/menus/{menuId}` and `/sellers/{sellerId}/menus/{menuId}/items/{itemId}`): These collections leverage hierarchical paths to clearly establish seller ownership. Buyers can perform `list` queries for active menus and their available items by first identifying a `sellerId` and then executing scoped queries, relying on `isActive`, `isAvailable`, and the denormalized `menuIsActive` for secure filtering. QAP for buyer menu items: `db.collection('sellers').doc(sellerId).collection('menus').doc(menuId).collection('items').where('isAvailable', '==', true).where('menuIsActive', '==', true)`.
*   Centralized Orders (`/orders/{orderId}`): This collection serves as a central hub for all orders. The explicit inclusion of `buyerProfileId` and `sellerId` within each document enables efficient `list` queries for both buyers (`.where('buyerProfileId', '==', request.auth.uid)`) and sellers (`.where('sellerId', '==', request.auth.uid)`), facilitating order tracking and driver management. This eliminates the need for complex multi-collection queries or `get()` calls.
*   Payment Transactions (`/paymentTransactions/{transactionId}`): This collection stores payment records and includes `buyerProfileId` and `orderId` for direct authorization. It provides efficient QAPs for buyers to view their transaction history (`.where('buyerProfileId', '==', request.auth.uid)`). This collection also serves as the trigger point for a Cloud Function to update `buyerProfile.subscriberStatus` upon successful payment.
*   Admin Roles (`/roles_admin/{adminUid}`): A dedicated, lightweight collection for DBAC. The mere existence of a document with an `adminUid` indicates an administrator role, enabling clear and robust rules like `allow read, write: if exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/roles_admin/$(request.auth.uid));`.

This architecture ensures that security rules are intuitive, maintainable, and highly performant, as all necessary authorization context is available within the `resource.data` object or implicitly within the request path.
